title: plus_one_ep01
style: photorealistic, cinematic 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, soft natural light, subtle film grain, vertical 9:16 composition, comedy series
negative_extra: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, logo, distorted face, extra fingers

sam.name: SAM
sam.look: Sam, a 27-year-old man with short messy dark-brown hair, light stubble and tired brown eyes, wearing a plain grey hoodie and a thin gold wedding ring

clone.name: CLONE #1
clone.look: Sam's clone, an identical 27-year-old man with neatly styled dark-brown hair, light stubble and a confident smirk, wearing a bright red hoodie

lena.name: LENA
lena.look: Lena, a 28-year-old woman with shoulder-length auburn hair and calm, sharp green eyes, wearing an elegant dark-green dress

mark.name: MARK
mark.look: Mark, a heavyset 50-year-old boss with a shaved head, a thick grey beard, a loud patterned shirt and a loosened tie

s10_photo.prompt: Phone photo of an empty chair at a candle-lit restaurant table, a small birthday cake with one lit candle in front of the empty chair, warm evening light, realistic smartphone photo

shots.title: Sam at desk
shots.keyframe: Medium close-up of {sam} sitting at a desk in a modern open-plan Amsterdam office, looking straight into the camera lens with a dry deadpan expression, mouth closed, laptop and coffee mug on the desk, blurred coworkers and canal-house windows behind him
shots.motion: {sam} looks straight into the camera with a deadpan expression and slowly raises one eyebrow, mouth closed, blurred coworkers move in the background, static camera

dialogue.text: Nobody tells you your clone can get a promotion.

shots.title: Phone insert
shots.keyframe: Top-down insert shot of a black smartphone lying face-up on a light wooden office desk next to a keyboard and a coffee mug, the phone screen dark and blank, shallow depth of field
shots.motion: The smartphone on the desk vibrates and its blank screen lights up softly, static top-down camera

overlays.text: Dinner at 7. It's my birthday. Don't be late.

shots.title: Boss enters
shots.keyframe: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind {sam} seated at his office desk, in the background {mark} strides toward the desk pointing at him enthusiastically, modern Amsterdam office
shots.motion: {mark} marches up to the desk, pointing and talking loudly with big gestures, {sam} slumps slightly in the foreground, static over-the-shoulder camera

dialogue.text: Adler, the Hartmann account review is at 7. You're leading it.
dialogue.say: Adler! The Hartmann account review is at seven. You're leading it!

shots.title: Ring
shots.keyframe: Extreme close-up of a man's hand resting on an office desk, a thin gold wedding ring on his ring finger catching the light, grey hoodie sleeve
shots.motion: The fingers turn the gold wedding ring once, a tiny glint of light flashes on the ring, slow push-in

shots.title: Summon face
shots.keyframe: Tight close-up of {sam}'s face, eyes closed in concentration, determined expression, a faint blue glow on his skin, dim office light
shots.motion: {sam} squeezes his eyes shut in concentration as a blue glow grows on his face, slow push-in

shots.title: Clone materializes
shots.keyframe: Medium shot in a modern office: a burst of bright blue light and anamorphic lens flare where {clone} has just appeared, standing next to an empty office chair, blue sparks fading in the air
shots.motion: {clone} appears out of a flash of blue light with lens flare, brushes off his red hoodie and looks around, bored and unimpressed, slow push-in

shots.title: Clone walks to meeting
shots.keyframe: Tracking shot through a glass meeting-room wall: {clone} walking confidently down a bright office corridor with long strides and a smirk, holding a laptop
shots.motion: {clone} walks confidently with long strides and a smirk past the glass wall, the camera tracks alongside him, he opens a glass door

dialogue.text: Clone #1 is the reliable one. Reliable means he never gets tired of being better than me.
dialogue.say: Clone number one is the reliable one. Reliable means he never gets tired of being better than me.

shots.title: Presentation
shots.keyframe: Meeting room with large windows: {clone} presenting confidently next to a big hand-drawn chart on a flip chart with a line shooting steeply upward, {mark} sitting at the table grinning with delight, coworkers watching
shots.motion: {clone} taps the hand-drawn chart with a marker, {mark} jumps up from his chair and applauds enthusiastically, coworkers nod

shots.title: Sam watches through glass
shots.keyframe: Wide shot of an office: in the foreground {sam} sits small at his desk with his face in his palm, behind him through a glass wall a meeting room celebration is visible
shots.motion: {sam} slowly sinks his face into his palm while people celebrate behind the glass wall, static wide camera

dialogue.text: Here's the problem. Every time he's sharp, I get a little fuzzy.

shots.title: Memory fails
shots.keyframe: Close-up of {sam}'s face with a blank, empty stare and slightly unfocused eyes, cool desaturated office light
shots.motion: {sam} stares blankly into space, then his eyes flicker with confusion, very slow push-in

dialogue.text: I can't remember where we had our first date anymore.

shots.title: Lena's text
shots.keyframe: Close-up insert of a smartphone lying on a dark office desk in the evening, its screen glowing, the office empty and dim
shots.motion: The phone on the desk vibrates gently and its screen glow flickers, static camera

overlays.text: Still coming? Or should I order for one?

shots.title: Promotion
shots.keyframe: Two-shot in a bright corner office with a canal view: {mark} shaking hands with {clone}, {clone} grinning smugly toward the camera
shots.motion: {mark} pats {clone} on the shoulder, talking excitedly, then {clone} turns to the camera and grins

shots.title: Restaurant reunion
shots.keyframe: Medium two-shot in a cosy Amsterdam restaurant at 9:40 pm with warm candle light: {lena} sitting at a table with a half-eaten birthday cake, looking quietly across the table at {sam}, a phone lying on the table, soft background bokeh
shots.motion: {lena} studies {sam} quietly across the table while he gives a tired smile, the candle flames flicker, the phone on the table lights up

overlays.text: Promotion done. Dinner's on me. Love you, babe.

end_card.title: Plus One: Clone #2 Wants a Turn.
end_card.subtitle: Part 2 Tomorrow.

Sitcom timing for the phone buzz
Cinematic impact on the blue light flash
Horn punch on the chart reveal at 21s
Drop everything except bass for the realization
Strings swell on the held note at 32s
